notes.col_a_purpose: records the diagnosis(s) noted for a specific examination (event), which may be null or list multiple conditions observed at that visit.
notes.col_b_purpose: stores each patient’s overall (master) diagnosis and is populated for every patient.
notes.use_a_when: when the query asks about diagnoses recorded during a particular exam or visit.
notes.use_b_when: when the query asks about a patient’s primary or overall diagnosis.
notes.sql_note: Join Examination to Patient on ID only if you need per‑visit diagnoses; otherwise query Patient.Diagnosis directly for the patient’s main condition.
pitfalls: Examination.Diagnosis has many nulls, so joining can unintentionally exclude patients without an exam record.
Values often differ in case or contain multiple comma‑separated conditions, so exact string matches may miss related diagnoses.
